rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a bleak, dismal situation or outlook.

example.english: The market is grim lately, and every shop says it is hard to get by.
example.traditional: 最近市道慘淡，間間舖頭都話難捱。
example.jyutping: zeoi3 gan6 si5 dou6 caam2 daam6 gaan1 gaan1 pou3 tau2 dou1 waa6 naan4 ngaai4

rows.note: Use this for determination that is firm and will not waver.

example.english: They kept going in the face of difficulties with grim determination.
example.traditional: 佢面對困難，仍然堅定不移咁行落去。
example.jyutping: keoi5 min6 deoi3 kwan3 naan4 jing4 jin4 gin1 ding6 bat1 ji4 gam3 haang4 lok6 heoi3

rows.note: Use this colloquial choice when grim means disgusting or gross.

example.english: Don’t talk about that grim stuff anymore—it’s so gross.
example.traditional: 你唔好再講嗰啲核突嘢啦，聽到都想嘔。
example.jyutping: nei5 m4 hou2 zoi3 gong2 go2 di1 wat6 dat6 je5 laa1 teng1 dou3 dou1 soeng2 au2
